from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List

class CompanyFinancialRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial data for a single company from one report."""
    company: str = Field(description="The full name of the company in the report")
    monetary_funds: float = Field(description="The monetary funds balance at period end in CNY")
    accounts_payable: float = Field(description="The accounts payable balance at period end in CNY")
    period_end: str = Field(description="The end date of the reporting period (YYYY-MM-DD)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregate of all records extracted from the current document batch."""
    company_records: List[CompanyFinancialRecord]
